title: Board Source Target Language Cleanup
description: Remove remaining in/out and from-style naming from board link gestures and engine edge structs; use source/target consistently.
summary: Renamed remaining board edge/handle language to source/target: React tests use sourceHandle/targetHandle; Rust vcompute compute_edge_bezier_points and WASM boardComputeEdgeBezier use source_/target_ parameters; BoardHost edge_curve locals aligned; TS computeEdgeBezier uses sourcePoint/targetPoint. Rust edge curve test uses source_radial/target_approach. Playwright: stable data-testid for fixture shelf, localStorage reset in beforeEach, webServer runs Vite only (no duplicate wasm-pack) to avoid mid-test HMR, reuseExistingServer false. Full nx run @elements/board:test passes.
